headline: Bank of India files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulations 31(4)–(5)
sum: Bank of India has submitted a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or voting rights triggering disclosure obligations under Regulations 31(4) and 31(5).
detail: Bank of India filed disclosure with NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filing cites Regulations 31(4) and 31(5), which mandate disclosure of substantial share acquisitions. Specific acquirer identity, acquisition percentage, and consideration amount are not disclosed in the headline announcement and require reference to the full disclosure document.
